STATUS: ANSWER
Two thresholds check FS. For INDEL variants the threshold is FS > 200.0 [G:Threshold:FS_gt_200_indel]. For SNP variants the threshold is FS > 60.0 [G:Threshold:FS_gt_60_snp]. Both are checked by the GATK source and belong to the hard-filtering procedure HF-01 [G:Procedure:HF-01].
